question.prompt: The longest professional tennis match ever played lasted a total of \(11\) hours and \(5\) minutes. How many minutes was this?

solutions.explanation:
Each hour contains \(60\) minutes, so \(11\) hours contains \(11\cdot60=660\) minutes. Adding the remaining \(5\) minutes gives
\[
660+5=\boxed{665\text{ minutes}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{C}\).
solutions.title: Convert hours to minutes
